answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11589 Country: India Title: Assalmalikum, I live in joint family in a house owned by my father and bear the full houehold expenses since my father does not work. My query is Can i show this amount as a rent in my office to get the tax benefit. Altough i made it clear to my office that we have our own house and this idea is suggested by them only. Jazakallah Question: Assalmalikum, I live in joint family in a house owned by my father and bear the full houehold expenses since my father does not work. My query is Can i show this amount as a rent in my office to get the tax benefit. Altough i made it clear to my office that we have our own house and this idea is suggested by them only. Jazakallah Answer ID: 11589 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 501/372=L/1430) If you make intention of house rent for the expenses incurred on household, it is allowable for you to manage it in the manner mentioned above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
